findings.body: The retained PR checker launches Autoreview without process-group options and calls started(pid), as verified in tests/fixtures/pr-check-before-branch-diff/review.py:531–533. This stop path nevertheless requests group termination through src/forge/codex.py:624–625. Because that child does not lead a process group, it remains alive and stop refuses without freeing its place. Migrated older Claude workers and readers have the same launch mismatch. The new group-member wait does not resolve this case; the existing-queue test migrates a newly grouped launch. Preserve safe cancellation for these ungrouped processes while retaining the ruled compatibility signatures.
findings.title: Handle existing agents without a dedicated process group

findings.body: The review entry snapshots chosen at admission, but Autoreview defaults and unavailable-model fallback update only selected at src/forge/review.py:570–576. Consequently, board JSON retains null or the unavailable model throughout the running review. The same stale snapshot occurs when a split design worker switches to Codex at src/forge/worker.py:167–191. Update the active entry's model and effort whenever either caller changes its selection. This previously reported advisory defect remains open.
findings.title: Refresh lane metadata when the selected model changes

findings.body: Actual tests still bypass the shared entry queue: src/forge/fasttest.py:171–172 launches directly, and close uses the separate ticket queue at src/forge/review.py:279–288. Board JSON therefore cannot expose running tests or their output/progress, and stop cannot cancel tests or stop an item's worker and test together. plans/FORGE-LANES-1.md:132–142 explicitly assigns this integration and its command-level checks to TESTS, so this remains deferred advice rather than an AGENTS blocker.
findings.title: Later: connect test entries and cancellation in TESTS
